from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, json
r=np.array(Image.open('inputs/red.png')).astype(np.float64)
n=np.array(Image.open('inputs/nir.png')).astype(np.float64)
s=n+r
nd=np.full(r.shape,np.nan)
m=s!=0
nd[m]=(n[m]-r[m])/s[m]
np.save('ndvi.npy',nd)
z={};cen={}
for rr in range(2):
  for c in range(3):
    k=rr*3+c+1
    z['Z%d'%k]=float(np.nanmean(nd[rr*30:(rr+1)*30,c*30:(c+1)*30])
